verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents several built-in AI features that perform work on the user's behalf. Its AI Editor builds and edits ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence and flags gaps, and due diligence reviews can be AI-assisted. These are narrow, feature-scoped AI functions rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to, and there is no hands-on corroboration. The external compliance-skills repo runs in outside agents, not inside the product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant/agent for delegating arbitrary tasks, depth documentation of what the AI Editor can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots
Sprinto supports both manual and AI-assisted due diligence reviews.
